# Pinball Map — account brief

## Who
Pinball Map is a user-updated pinball locator, offered as a website and a free mobile app, that helps people find public pinball machines in their area ([source](https://pinballmap.com/)). Its code lives in the pinballmap GitHub org, linked to pinballmap.com ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap)).

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is present in the pbm-react repo ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react/blob/e939c6d82311766dedd2d4abc1e3d523a4870be4/eas.json))
- The app is on react-native 0.86.0 ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react/blob/master/package.json))
- pbm-react was last pushed on 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react))
- The org has 8 public repos and 20 followers, consistent with a small team ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap))

## Why now
The repo was pushed as recently as 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react)). It is on react-native 0.86.0 ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react/blob/master/package.json)). The evidence contains no store listing data, so release cadence in the app stores is unknown.

## Suggested opener
I noticed pbm-react ships with an `eas.json`, so you are already building through EAS ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react/blob/e939c6d82311766dedd2d4abc1e3d523a4870be4/eas.json)). You are also current on react-native 0.86.0, which most teams your size fall behind on ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react/blob/master/package.json)). When you push a fix like the ones landing this month, do you wait on a full store review, or are you using EAS Update to get it to players directly ([source](https://github.com/pinballmap/pbm-react))?
